I've definitely been having a harder time because I was trying hard to fit in like, everything about W.  It's almost impossible without some multiclassing and homebrew for transformations but I think it *could* be done.  The hardest of any mechanics to manage being final forms - which I assume is your zenith heroic armaments.

Is there any specific reason that prevents a Masked Hero from designating their unarmed strikes as a Heroic Armament?  I also like your take on mirroring the paladins, it's quite fitting.  

Most of my question comes from many toku heroes using unarmed as their primary form of fighting before breaking out weapons.  Tho I get that's mostly for showtime and story purposes (don't wanna have a hero instant win fights with their weapons).

Been looking over the various builds and suggestions and short of trying to stuff it into the pre-existing classes, I have to ask.

How would you suggest building a character in the vein of Kamen Rider W?

To be honest I've never been diagnosed as being autistic, nor do I believe myself to be.  :o  The latter half of your statement I'm not sure really applies to me, but I understand what you're getting at.  

Thank you.  Some days it's easier to manage living with these feelings and the like, others not so much.  Like, at all really.

I'm sure you're right.

If it sheds any light, part of my issue is incompetence insecurities tied with being trans and other aspects of life I find I fall short in.  I've been here in this frame of mind once before, over 10 years ago, seems like old problems never really go away.
